notes.title: New Year, New Game! ❤️
notes.notes:
Favorite players, 2024 is coming to an end, and this winter, a new game is coming out. With your names in the credits.

About the past.

When HOSPICE Vol. 1 was strictly a game for me and catered to my interests at the time, Cat Got Your Tongue was a game for you, and I'm so glad you loved it so much! And even though the game didn't achieve huge financial success, man. Up to 10 videos on YouTube, so I have a gift for you. Everyone who made it into the credits of the previous game - you're in the credits again! All the reviews I liked under the game were also added to the credits of the new game. [b]And for those who still want to get into the credits or send a greeting, do it now. Write directly under this post while there's still time before the release.[/b] Speaking of the future, [b]I've started a Patreon. [/b]So, everyone, desired and undesired, please support me in development :D https://www.patreon.com/fyuriy And now about the game itself, it will be an erotic 18+ furry visual novel but I assure you, you'll love THIS novel.

notes.title: Cat Got Your Tongue is coming for you on May 1st!
notes.notes:
[b]Cat Got Your Tongue[/b] is a horror point-and-click game where you must escape from the Cat by exploring the darkest corners of the house.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930140/Cat_Got_Your_Tongue/
[h2]Cat Got Your Tongue is coming for you on May 1st![/h2]
And while other companies are looking for employees, I'm looking for buyers. (blink)

You? [i]You[/i]? Or maybe [b]YOU[/b] can already add the game to your wishlist (it will be interesting to see how many of you). So, let's give the game a warm welcome into the indie horror family.

And to add a little extra heat, [b]you'll get a 30% discount[/b] on release! The discount will last [i]two weeks[/i], so don't miss out.

All monster-cat enthusiasts are welcome in the game's credits [u]this July[/u]. [i]Small rewards are also expected[/i]. (heart)

notes.title: A new game is coming out and... I want to talk about it :D
notes.notes:
[h1]It's been a year and a half since the release of HOSPICE Vol. 1[/h1]
And no, it's not HOPSICE Vol. 2, and no, there won't be any settings menu there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43193026/507feef006ab9c7a716b80cdffca81cf3d05f7ff.jpg[/img]

[b]On November 24, 2022[/b], HOSPICE Vol. 1 saw the light of day, my first game [b]on Steam[/b]. And honestly, it's my dream to develop games for others. Just think about it. [i]28,000 copies[/i] spread worldwide, and I'm very grateful to everyone who played.

So, what's next? [b]The game that will be released later this month[/b] is not a visual novel. It's something bigger for me. It's my letter of gratitude to the person who inspired me to make games.

That person is Scott, [b]Scott Cawthon[/b]. [i]A well-known figure, isn't he?[/i] (smiley)

I would be very happy if you played it and even happier to read your review. Game development is an interesting part of the process, but seeing your screenshots and comments is the most fun. Even a Let's Play was made for HOSPICE Vol. 1, and it's for a "[i]questionable[/i]" visual novel, like mine (teeth)

I see each of you and leave rewards for favorites [b](heart)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43193026/8399007a995aa14cd2aca665b74494887e8f9147.jpg[/img]

The game post will be up right after Steam moderation. Hoping for your support.

[i]With love, Dima Fyuriy ~[/i]
